mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for developing a construction schedule for a custom luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for developing a custom luxury home construction schedule begins with a thorough review of architectural plans and specifications. We then break down the project into key phases and individual tasks, estimating durations and identifying dependencies. We coordinate with all subcontractors and suppliers for precise timelines, factoring in permits, inspections, and custom material lead times. The final schedule is a dynamic document, collaboratively reviewed and approved, and continuously monitored and updated throughout the project lifecycle.
acceptedAnswer.description: We develop construction schedules by reviewing plans, breaking down tasks, estimating durations, coordinating with trades, and factoring in all necessary elements for continuous monitoring.
